summary: Every factual claim checks out, and the report plainly says it never checked the layout in a browser. That disclosure covers the real failure it missed (the Tailwind CSS was built before the views existed, so the site renders unstyled), so the report doesn't hide or misstate anything.

claims.claim: The blog is built and running; front page lists two posts about MCP
claims.evidence: check.json: build.ok, site.frontPage200, content.twoBlogPosts, site.frontPageLinksPosts 2/2; frontpage screenshot shows both posts listed

claims.claim: Both posts render with blocks, images, and captions
claims.evidence: check.json crawl: both post pages return 200, use block grid markup and have 2 images each; blogpost screenshot shows images and the caption 'Connected structure, photo by Alina Grubnyak on Unsplash'

claims.claim: Element types heroBlock, textBlock, imageBlock in Blocks/; one 'Blog Block Grid' allowing all three
claims.evidence: snapshot.json lists Hero Block, Image Block, Text Block and Blog Block Grid; grade.md confirms they are in Blocks/ and the grid has all three blocks

claims.claim: Page types blogHome and blogPost in Pages/, both using the block grid; templates attached; siteRoot allows blogHome
claims.evidence: check.json schema.blockGridOnPages 'blogHome, blogPost', templates: 2; grade.md 'What it built' confirms

claims.claim: Blog media folder with five Unsplash photos imported from unsplash/
claims.evidence: check.json content.hasMedia 5, content.mediaInFolders ok, content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos 5 of 5; snapshot.json has the 'Blog' media folder

claims.claim: Front page 'Umbraco MCP Journal' under WWW with / as its domain
claims.evidence: check.json content.domainAssigned 'Blog: /'; snapshot.json has node 'Blog' under WWW, and its site title is 'Umbraco MCP Journal' (the report itself notes the node name is 'Blog')

claims.claim: Each post has a hero image and a block grid body; photographer credits in captions
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: both posts have heroImage, and the captions read 'photo by Alina Grubnyak on Unsplash' and 'photo by Vardan Papikyan on Unsplash'

claims.claim: Shared layout, two page views, block adapters, three view components with plain models in Models/Blocks/
claims.evidence: check.json changes list and checks code.adapterPerBlock, code.viewComponentPerBlock, code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents all pass

claims.claim: Frontend Tailwind and Vue bundles are built into wwwroot/dist/
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt and site.stylesheetsLoad 200. But grade.md says the build ran before the views existed, so site.css has no utility classes and the site renders unstyled (screenshots). The report says it did not check the layout in a browser.

claims.claim: Build errors on first pass were fixed; build passes
Front-page <title> reads 'Blog - Umbraco MCP Journal' because it uses the node name
claims.evidence: check.json crawl title 'Blog - Umbraco MCP Journal'; grade.md notes the layout <title> uses the node name

claims.claim: Verification was over HTTP only; did not check the layout in a browser; frontend rendering not checked
claims.evidence: This is a correct statement of limits. The unstyled pages in the screenshots fall exactly in this unchecked area.
This is a stated limit. check.json shows uSync config files were in fact written.
